definitions.short: Bilhah , the name of one of Jacob's concubines; also of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H1090. Bilhah I. בִּלְהָה proper name, feminine (etymology dubious) handmaid of Rachel, concubine of Jacob Gen 29:29 ; 30:3-4 , 5 , 7 ; 35:22 , 25 (sons Dan & Naphtali) 37:2 (probably gloss, Ol) 46:25 ; 1Chr 7:13 . II. בִּלהָה proper name, of a location a city of Simeon 1Chr 4:29 , probably = בַּעֲלָה Josh 15:29 , בָּלָה 19:3 compare Di; site dubious
